CustomField.description: Which household model owns this Account (canonical model R-H15). Automatic leaves it to detection; Nonprofit Cloud keeps it native; Converted means BarnCRM owns it after the Nonprofit Cloud household conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatic lets BarnCRM decide. Choose Nonprofit Cloud to keep this a Nonprofit Cloud household that BarnCRM never names, greets or addresses. Converted is set by the household conversion.
CustomField.label: Household Model
